description:
Hanuman Ne Suraj Ko Phal Samjha Liya! ☀️

🔱 Baby Hanuman ate sun confused fruit Indra vajra curse

As a child, baby Hanuman saw the rising sun and mistook it for a ripe red fruit. He flew into the sky to eat it. Rahu (eclipse demon) was also trying to swallow the sun. Indra struck Hanuman with his Vajra (thunderbolt) to save the sun, injuring Hanuman's jaw. Vayu (Wind god/Hanuman's father) became so angry he withdrew all air from the universe. All beings suffocated until gods restored Hanuman and apologized.

👉 Ek bacche ki galti — poori duniya rooh rakhti hai! Kaisa laga?
